source_read: Apex Hotels' own restaurant pages for Chambers (Apex Temple Court, London), The Lampery (Apex City of London) and The Orange Artichoke (Apex City of Bath) on www.apexhotels.co.uk (robots.txt allows /destinations/ and /media/), and the 15 breakfast, brunch, a la carte, bar and dessert PDFs they link (spring/summer 2026 files, plus The Lampery's June 2025 breakfast PDF, which its page still links as 'Breakfast'), fetched 2026-10-12. The Scottish hotels' breakfast menus (Quayside, Metro, Liberte) were opened and print no calories; Bath's breakfast prints none either.
not_verifiable: whether the Scottish restaurants serve the same dishes with the same calories (their menus print none; the note says figures are from the restaurants in England); allergens are not published online ('please ask a team member')
notes: Second read by another tool: every menu re-read with pdftotext -raw (not the extractor's pdftohtml runs and fonts), each published name searched in all 15 texts and the next '(NNNkcal)' after it compared with items.csv. Every published item's own entry gives the published figure at Chambers and at The Lampery (both Lampery breakfast versions agree where both print it); the other hits are the same words inside another dish's description (e.g. 'spinach' in The Full Vegan), checked by eye. Breakfast parts were read off the rendered text too: 'Croissant (306kcal) Pain au Chocolat (288kcal) Danish Pastry (315kcal) Blueberry Muffin (471kcal) Chocolate Chip Muffin (561kcal)', 'natural (198kcal) or fruit yoghurt (210kcal)', 'Orange (87kcal) Apple (148kcal) Grapefruit (135kcal) ... Cranberry (73kcal)' identical on both restaurants' menus; Pineapple's figure sits on the next line at The Lampery and is left out. 0 differences. The second read found three near-identical names at The Orange Artichoke with other figures (Artisan Cheese Selection 423, Parmesan & Truffle Fries 573, Burrata Salad 518), so Cheese Selection, Truffle & Parmesan Fries and Burrata are held back. 23 names that print different figures at different restaurants (The Full Monty 1002 / 1160, Eggs Benedict 514 / 463, Club Sandwich 1226 / 772...) are left out, never chosen between.
